name: @saasreport/fa-lint
description: The mechanical Persian check: a JSON-Schema-validated rule pack (typography, ZWNJ, ی/ک, digits, bidi, and every owner correction of wording and word order, each with must-fail and must-pass examples), a normalizer (parts from Virastar, MIT) and the engine behind `kit check persian` and the podcast gate before TTS. No dependencies; runs in Workers, Node ≥ 20 and browsers.
